title: Senior Corporate Partnerships Manager
description:
About DonorsChoose
DonorsChoose is an education nonprofit ensuring every US public school student has the classroom resources they need to learn, grow, and thrive.
Founded by a teacher in 2000, DonorsChoose connects educators with a nationwide community of supporters who believe investing in students today will transform tomorrow. Educators request the materials they know their students need, and donors can choose the classroom, community, or cause they want to support. Since our founding, donors have supported 90% of US public schools. Every request is vetted, resources are delivered to classrooms, and donors can see the impact of their support through transparent reporting and updates from students and teachers. Raising $1.9 billion for classrooms, DonorsChoose has earned top ratings from Charity Navigator, GuideStar, and CharityWatch for its transparency, trust, and impact. Our dedicated team works from across the United States to turn resources into opportunities for students and teachers.
About the Corporate Partnerships Team
Our team raises funds for classrooms by building and executing philanthropic partnerships with corporations and renewing and growing those partnerships over time. Read more about our partnerships.
About the Role
DonorsChoose is seeking a Senior Corporate Partnerships Manager to grow and steward a portfolio of strategic corporate partners while helping evolve how we build long-term, mission-driven partnerships.
This is more than traditional account management. Our strongest partnerships create meaningful value for both our partners and the classrooms we serve. Success requires curiosity, commercial thinking, exceptional relationship management, and the ability to translate partner objectives into creative, measurable philanthropic strategies.
As a senior individual contributor, you will own a portfolio of complex corporate relationships who each contribute $250K+ annually, while helping shape partnership strategy, identifying new opportunities for growth, and contributing to how the team continues to evolve.

Build and Grow Strategic Partnerships

• Contribute meaningfully toward annual fundraising goals through a portfolio of sophisticated corporate partnerships.

• Translate corporate priorities into high-impact partnerships through creative campaigns, employee engagement opportunities, and storytelling.

• Use data, insights, and impact reporting to demonstrate value and strengthen long-term relationships.

• Partner with internal teams to ensure successful implementation while balancing partner experience with organizational scalability.

description:
Devenez chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire
Accédez à des missions rémunérées de convoyage de véhicules partout en France, avec une organisation flexible et des frais de route pris en charge.
👉 Inscrivez-vous ici pour accéder aux missions :
DriiveMe est la plateforme leader européen du convoyage de véhicules. Chaque mois, plus de 20 000 missions rémunérées sont proposées à notre communauté de chauffeurs et convoyeurs indépendants partout en France.
Les grands acteurs de l’automobile font confiance à DriiveMe pour déplacer leurs véhicules : Stellantis, Aramisauto, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar , et bien d’autres.
Partout en France, des centaines de sociétés ont besoin de déplacer des véhicules d’un point A à un point B. Elles publient chaque jour leurs besoins sur DriiveMe afin de proposer ces missions à la communauté DriiveMe Partenaire.
En quoi consiste une mission DriiveMe ?
C’est simple : en tant que chauffeur indépendant, vous conduisez un véhicule d’un point A vers un point B. Voici comment ça fonctionne :

• Vous créez votre compte sur

• Vous accédez aux missions disponibles dans votre région.

• Vous consultez le trajet, la rémunération et les conditions de chaque mission.

• Vous réservez en quelques clics les missions que vous souhaitez réaliser.

• Le jour de la mission, vous récupérez le véhicule au point de départ et le livrez au point d’arrivée.

• Une fois la mission terminée et validée, vous recevez votre paiement automatiquement sous 10 jours.

Pourquoi devenir chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire ?

• Complément de revenus : chaque mission est rémunérée, avec un prix connu à l’avance.

• Organisation flexible : vous choisissez librement les missions que vous souhaitez effectuer.

• Frais de route pris en charge : carburant et péages sont remboursés selon les conditions de la mission.

• Plateforme simple et intuitive : consultation, réservation et suivi des missions en ligne.

• Missions partout en France : de nouvelles opportunités sont publiées chaque jour.

Combien suis-je rémunéré ?
Votre chiffre d'affaires dépend du nombre de missions que vous choisissez de réaliser.
Chaque mission dispose d’une rémunération spécifique, définie selon le trajet, le nombre de kilomètres et la complexité du transport.
Avant de réserver une mission, vous connaissez les informations essentielles : lieu de départ, lieu d’arrivée, rémunération et conditions de prise en charge . Vous êtes libre de réserver uniquement les missions qui vous conviennent.
Profil recherché
Pour rejoindre DriiveMe Partenaire, vous devez idéalement :

• disposer d’un permis B valide ;

• être indépendant ou prêt à le devenir ;

• être sérieux, ponctuel et rigoureux ;

• respecter les procédures de prise en charge et de livraison des véhicules ;

• être disponible pour réaliser des missions ponctuelles dans votre région ou ailleurs en France.

title: Hiker worden bij Gire!
description:
Verdien flexibel geld met het rijden van auto’s 🚗
🚗 Verdien flexibel geld met het rijden van auto's
Bepaal zelf wanneer je werkt en verdien geld door auto's van A naar B te rijden voor verschillende bedrijven door heel Nederland. We zijn in 2019 gestart in Oslo, sinds 2024 ook actief in Nederland, en inmiddels uitgegroeid tot bijna 350.000 ritten in alle vier de landen.
Voor wie je rijdt
Gire is een digitaal platform dat auto's verplaatst voor bedrijven. Geen vaste klant, geen sleur: je rijdt bij een wisselende mix van opdrachtgevers, zoals deelauto-platforms, verhuurbedrijven, dealers en leasemaatschappijen.
Hoe het werkt
Onze vaste werkwijze is dat je werkvoorkeuren opgeeft. Doe je dat niet, dan krijg je ook geen volwaardige planning voor die dag.

• Werkvoorkeuren doorgeven: je geeft aan vanaf welke locatie en tijd je wilt starten, en tot welke locatie en tijd je terug wilt zijn. Dit kan tot twee weken vooruit, en tot een dag van tevoren.

• Je krijgt een planning op basis van je voorkeur: planningen worden een dag van tevoren gemaakt en op basis daarvan sturen we je een voorstel. Je bent niet verplicht om op vaste dagen te werken, pas vanaf het moment dat je accepteert is het jouw verantwoordelijkheid.

• Soms komen er op de dag zelf nog extra ritten bij , die je naast je planning kan oppakken, bijvoorbeeld voor of na je studie.

Wat je verdient
Je wordt per rit betaald, niet per uur. Reken je je hele werkdag van deur tot deur om, inclusief de tijd die je onderweg bent met het OV, dan kom je gemiddeld uit op zo'n €17 tot €22 per uur, afhankelijk van hoe efficiënt je rijdt. Dit geldt zowel voor de ritten uit je planning als voor de extra ritten die er soms op de dag zelf bijkomen. Let op: je OV-reistijd telt dus mee in je verdiensten, maar de OV-kosten zelf worden niet vergoed.
Wat ga je doen

• Auto's ophalen en afleveren op verschillende locaties door heel Nederland.

• Zelfstandig onderweg zijn, van deelauto's herpositioneren tot klantleveringen en dealervervoer.

• Klanten vriendelijk helpen bij overdrachten.

• Zorgvuldig omgaan met verschillende auto's.

Wie zoeken we

• Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar rijbewijs B.

• Je kunt handgeschakeld rijden.

• Je spreekt Nederlands.

• Je bent representatief en zelfstandig.

• Je vindt autorijden leuk.

• Minimaal 1 volle werkdag doordeweeks beschikbaar, de rest bepaal je zelf.

Ervaring is niet nodig.
Wat krijg je

• Flexibel werk naast je studie of andere baan.

• Zelf bepalen wanneer je werkt.

• Elke rit is verzekerd.

• Werken via een moderne app.

• Mogelijkheid om mee te groeien met een snelgroeiende scale-up.

Goed om te weten
Je werkt als zelfstandig ondernemer/freelancer. Heb je nog geen KvK of btw-nummer? Geen probleem, we leggen je tijdens het kennismakingsgesprek uit hoe dat werkt.
Solliciteren duurt maar een paar minuten.

Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores ' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60-70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.

This internship sits alongside our Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who embed with customer teams and ship production agentic AI systems on AWS. You won't carry a delivery commitment on day one instead, you'll work under an FDE's mentorship to learn how agentic systems get built, tested, and verified against real customer data, and you'll get structured exposure to the judgment calls that sit behind every shipped feature.

This is a learning-and-building role, not a staff-augmentation seat and not an advisory role. You'll write real code that feeds into real engagements, under close supervision.

• Support delivery of agentic AI and AWS modernization work across our three pillars: Data Platform Modernization, Application & Database Modernization, and AI Agents for Apps.

• Assist in converting existing product or process functionality into callable agent tools, under supervision.

• Sit in on architecture sessions and customer discussions to learn how design decisions get made and defended; you'll observe and contribute, not lead.

• Help document agent decisions and test evidence so outputs are traceable and defensible.

• Genuine curiosity about agentic AI: how agents plan, use tools, retrieve context, and get evaluated. You don't need to have shipped an agent, you need to want to learn how they're built properly.

• Basic familiarity with cloud concepts; AWS exposure through coursework, certifications-in-progress, or personal projects is a plus.

• Comfort with testing-driven habits, willingness to learn to write test cases before code, not after.

title: Software Engineer - Network Automation (Go/Python) (f/m/d)
description:
Exoscale is the leading Swiss/European cloud service provider, offering a full spectrum of cloud infrastructure services-from instantly deployable virtual machines to S3-compatible object storage. Our mission is to deliver a simple, scalable cloud experience that enables our customers to focus on what they do best.

We’re a distributed team headquartered in Lausanne, driven by a culture of openness, technical excellence, and collaboration. We value diversity and strive to provide an inclusive, flexible, and empowering work environment.

About the Role

Our network team builds and runs Exoscale 's network: the edge, the datacenter fabrics, and the out-of-band network across all of our European zones.

We are hiring a full-time software engineer to join that team and own one thing: the orchestration that takes a network change from a merged pull request to running on production devices, automatically and safely.

Today our network is described as code. Device configuration is generated from our sources of truth and reviewed in pull requests. The step after that, rolling the change out to the network, still depends too much on an engineer at a terminal. We want that to become an orchestrated workflow, with the guarantees software teams take for granted from their deployment pipelines: validated before it ships, rolled out progressively, verified afterwards, and rolled back when something looks wrong.

This is a software engineering role inside a network team. You will not be expected to design the backbone, but you will work every day with the engineers who do, and what you build decides how fast and how safely they can change it.

Location: Spain, Germany or Remote in EU

What You’ll Be Working On:

• Design and build the orchestration of network changes. This goes beyond a deployment pipeline: it coordinates multi-step operations across devices and systems, with pre-change validation, staged rollout, post-change verification, and automatic rollback.

• Write the services and tooling behind it in Go and Python, with the tests, CI, and observability you would expect of any production software.

• Build a test environment (virtual labs, config and state checks) that lets us catch a bad change before it reaches a device.

• Extend our source-of-truth and config-generation tooling (NetBox, Peering Manager, Ansible/Jinja2) so that more of the network is described by data instead of by hand.

• Make the network’s state visible: detect drift between intended and running configuration, and expose it to the team.

• Take part in code and infrastructure change reviews, and raise the software engineering bar of the team.

• Join the on-call rotation after a training period.

About you:

You are a software engineer first, and you find infrastructure more interesting than CRUD apps. You may come from a network automation, SRE, or platform engineering background.

You have:

• Solid professional experience designing, writing, and maintaining production software in Go, and fluency in Python.

• Experience building CI/CD or deployment systems where a failed rollout has real consequences.

• A habit of testing what you ship and automating what you do twice.

• A working understanding of networking fundamentals (IP, routing, VLANs, what BGP is for). You don’t need to be a network engineer; you need to be curious enough to become dangerous.

• Strong written and spoken English, and comfort working in a distributed team.

It’s a plus if you have:

• Automated network devices before (Arista EOS, Junos, SONiC), through NETCONF, gNMI, eAPI, or similar.

• Used Ansible, NetBox, or comparable configuration-management and source-of-truth tools at scale.

• Worked with network test or validation tooling (containerlab, Batfish, pyATS, or similar).

• Experience with Linux networking and Kubernetes.

What we offer:

• A problem with real scope and ownership: you build the orchestration, not a ticket queue around it.

• Flexible hours and the ability to work

A hands-on technical artist who owns the path from finished 2D art and animation to working assets in Unity. They build the tools, standards, and validation that make handoffs reliable, keep templates and IP reskins fast, and help the team adopt AI-assisted workflows where they genuinely help.
The role
As Technical Artist, you will own the tooling and standards behind this journey. You'll work directly with discipline leads and Engineering to cut manual work, catch integration errors early, and make sure assets look and behave in playable builds as intended.
What you'll own

• Evaluate the art and animation pipeline and technical stack, identify visual or creative requirements that existing workflows cannot support, and propose practical solutions or alternatives that align with production constraints.

• Build and maintain tools: Write practical scripts, exporters, importers, and validation checks that remove repetitive work.

• Define asset standards: Set conventions for structure, naming, export settings, versioning, and "ready for implementation" criteria.

• Own Unity asset setup: Define how visual assets and animations are integrated efficiently in Unity, including prefabs, reusable configurations, and animation integration.

• Validate in builds: Check that assets look and behave correctly on device, and diagnose visual defects, integration issues, and mobile performance problems.

• Keep the pipeline healthy: Find bottlenecks, trace recurring issues to their root cause, and fix them across Art, Animation, Design, and Engineering.

• Enable reuse: Structure assets, rigs, animations, and setups so they carry across games, levels, and IP reskins with minimal rework.

• Evolve the workflow: Evaluate new tools and pipeline changes, including our exploration of a move from Adobe Animate to Spine, and help teams adopt them.

• Introduce AI-assisted workflows: Identify where AI tools can safely speed up production, pilot them with the team, set guardrails for quality and licensed-IP use, and document what works.

• Document and support: Write clear documentation, train colleagues, and make tools usable by people with different levels of technical confidence.

What you'll bring

• Hands-on experience integrating 2D art and animation into Unity for shipped or production-ready games.

• Experience with node-based shader editors (e.g., Amplify Shader Editor, Shader Graph), including creating custom shaders and effects tailored to the creative needs of each project.

Job Duck is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Billing Administrator to support the accurate and timely management of billing, accounts receivable, payment processing, and collections activities. About the Team

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments worldwide. We work across the full funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention and monetization, through product experiments, in-product improvements, performance marketing, creative development, and AI-powered workflows.

The International Growth team works with regional leaders in priority markets to identify the user needs and product gaps that matter most for adoption, usage, and monetization. We turn market priorities into product roadmaps and growth plans, then partner with engineering, research, design, data science, marketing, finance, policy, and partnerships to test and ship improvements.

We combine product strategy with hands-on growth operations. We account for local behavior, competition, and product experience while building shared capabilities such as segmentation, lifecycle journeys, and experimentation systems. We measure what ships, adapt it to the market, and scale approaches that work across markets.

About the Role

We’re looking for a growth lead for Brazil to shape and execute ChatGPT’s growth plans. You’ll partner with regional and market leaders to understand users across Brazil, prioritize the biggest growth opportunities across markets, and turn those priorities into product improvements, funnel optimizations, and performance marketing tests. You’ll work across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, collaborating with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to influence priorities and ship measurable impact. The role combines product growth and funnel optimization with performance marketing: connecting audience, message, creative, and channel learnings to better in-product journeys.

In this role, you will:

- Partner with regional and market leaders to set a Brazil growth plan and market-level roadmap priorities, with clear hypotheses, owners, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.

- Use user research, funnel and cohort data, and competitive insight to find local friction and prioritize the opportunities that matter most to users.

- Run performance marketing tests in collaboration with regional marketers across relevant channels, creators, and partners; use incrementally, CAC, payback, and LTV to decide what to scale.

- Design and run rigorous experiments across onboarding, activation, repeat usage, re-engagement, and paid conversion; measure incremental impact and iterate. Work with Product, Engineering, Design, and Data Science partners to prototype, test, and ship locally relevant experiences.

- Partner with regional Marketing and central media teams to brief and prioritize audience, positioning, creative, and channel tests based on the regional plan and market priorities.

- Own the regional growth scorecard with market-level views across acquisition, retention, paid conversion, and unit economics, distinguishing incremental user and revenue gains and learnings. Connect priority use cases, product improvements, and acquisition plans into a coherent journey from first exposure to repeated value.

- Run the growth operating cadence with regional and market leaders, aligning central and local partners on results, trade-offs, dependencies, and next steps.

- Build and operate segmentation, lifecycle journeys, growth tooling, performance marketing and product experimentation capabilities that can be scaled across markets.

You might thrive if you have:

- 10+ years of experience across product growth, growth marketing, data science, or growth strategy and operations, with hands-on execution in a fast-moving technology company.

- A user-first track record of turning local research and behavior into product and growth priorities, then shipping improvements with measurable impact.

- Strong command of acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization funnels, including technically rigorous experimentation and interpretation.

From automating and simplifying core operations including billing to create a lower-cost, higher-engagement experience, to optimising energy usage across smart devices in the home, we turn tough challenges into win-win-win outcomes for customers, suppliers and the energy system.

We champion a flexible, hybrid work approach and we find that teams often benefit from coming together in the office at least 3 days a week to foster connection and accelerate progress.

Outside of these collaborative opportunities, we aim to be as flexible as possible to balance work with life. As a company we come together annually for our conference and end of year celebrations!

Our goal is to build a self-sufficient and empowered team here on the ground in Australia. We’re well on our way, but until we get there we still have some reliances on our UK team. Being comfortable working flexibly for a portion of your working week to cover time zones is required.

What will I be doing?

You’ll be working on Kaluza’s Energy Retail platform, a SaaS technology platform that aims to revolutionise the operating platforms of energy retailers globally. Built with scale and technical quality in mind, it is the foundation for the decarbonisation efforts of Kaluza’s customers.

You’ll be joining the Kaluza Technology community, a large team of data-led and product-focused Software and Production Engineers pushing the boundaries of technology at extraordinary scale. Together, we strive for engineering greatness by upholding best practices across the whole community.

Here at Kaluza we are 100% committed to providing a reliable platform for our clients. After hours support is assigned according to a paid roster.

We believe strongly in shared ownership of both responsibilities and successes across our team. As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in shaping and delivering our work from the outset. You’ll be exposed to - and help lead on - many aspects of our diverse portfolio, contributing to everything from hands-on engineering to technical decision-making and mentoring.

Our teams build, test, deploy, and support a range of services that manage the customer lifecycle and metering data for the Kaluza platform, using a wide variety of technologies. While you don’t need to have prior experience with all of them, you’ll bring strong engineering fundamentals and a track record of quickly picking up new tools and practices. You’ll typically work with TypeScript and interact with technologies including GitHub Actions, Terraform, Kubernetes, Serverless, DynamoDB or Postgres, AWS, and DataDog.

We follow agile practices and use tools like Miro, Confluence and Jira to support collaborative working and delivery. You’ll help drive good practices, shape team ceremonies, and evolve how we work.

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

Our security tools continuously scan application code and live services, aggregating findings directly into DefectDojo. • Maintain and test integrations between tools, including REST APIs, webhooks, data importers, and ticket synchronization.

• Deploy updates and configuration changes, always validating them in the test environment first.

• Keep runbooks, known issues, and tool documentation accurate and up to date.

• You work independently within established runbooks, communicate transparently, and prefer asking questions over guessing.

We value diversity and welcome all applications - regardless of, for example, gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity, physical characteristics, marital status or any other irrelevant factor subject to applicable law.

title: Forward Deployed Finance Engineer, Private Credit

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow.

In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work.

This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook - demo library, workflow templates, use cases - while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows.

You may be asked to travel around 2-3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1-3 days at a time.

The work is the work they did on the desk: lender presentation and CIM review; QoE read-throughs and data pack analysis; cash flow and leverage modeling; sizing and structuring; covenant and credit agreement review; credit memo drafting; and comps. title: Sourcing Ops Intern

Our business runs on finding exceptional experts - fast, at quality, at volume - and communicating so clearly that a banker or physician knows exactly what the project is before the first call, and delivers high-quality work from day one.

description:

Chez MFSG, nos équipes et nos services unissent leurs efforts pour accomplir quelque chose qui nous dépasse : créer des solutions qui éliminent les obstacles et donnent accès à des fonds que certaines personnes ne pourraient obtenir ailleurs. Que vous résolviez des problèmes, développiez des systèmes ou définissiez des stratégies, votre travail contribue à offrir un soutien concret à des personnes bien réelles.

Aperçu du poste

La personne responsable de l’acquisition de talents bilingue collabore avec les dirigeants de l’entreprise pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de recrutement novatrices qui répondent aux besoins immédiats d’embauche et soutiennent les objectifs à long terme en matière de talents dans les marchés anglophones et francophones. Elle veille à offrir une expérience candidat fluide et inclusive, tout en maintenant des normes élevées d’excellence en recrutement.

Principales responsabilités

1. Acquisition et recherche de talents - 20 %

•
Mettre en œuvre les meilleures pratiques de recrutement afin de répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs en matière d’embauche dans des marchés bilingues et multiculturels.

•
Utiliser le système de suivi des candidatures Greenhouse et divers canaux de recherche de talents, notamment LinkedIn, les sites d’emploi et les partenariats communautaires, pour attirer les meilleurs talents bilingues.

•
Susciter l’intérêt de personnes bilingues qui ne sont pas activement à la recherche d’un emploi grâce à des démarches de recrutement proactives et à des initiatives de marque employeur.

•
Se tenir au fait des tendances du marché des talents, des défis de recrutement et des nouvelles possibilités de recherche de candidatures.

2. Évaluation et sélection des candidatures - 20 %

•
Effectuer l’analyse des curriculum vitæ, les présélections et les entrevues en français et en anglais afin d’assurer un processus d’embauche équitable et fluide.

•
Mener des entrevues auprès de bassins de talents diversifiés afin d’évaluer l’adéquation avec la culture organisationnelle, les compétences techniques et la correspondance avec les exigences du poste.

•
Négocier des offres d’emploi concurrentielles conformes aux politiques de l’entreprise et aux pratiques du marché de l’emploi bilingue.

•
Orienter et améliorer les stratégies de recrutement inclusives afin de favoriser un effectif diversifié et représentatif dans un milieu équitable.

•
Vérifier régulièrement les offres d’emploi pour en assurer l’exactitude, l’accessibilité et la visibilité dans les deux langues.

4. Optimisation des processus et indicateurs - 20 %

•
Optimiser l’utilisation de Greenhouse pour la recherche de talents, l’embauche, la production de rapports et le suivi des indicateurs clés de performance dans les deux langues.

•
Analyser chaque semaine les données d’acquisition de talents, notamment les candidatures, les embauches, les délais de dotation et la répartition des compétences selon la langue.

•
Repérer les possibilités d’amélioration des processus afin d’accélérer les embauches et d’en améliorer la qualité.

•
Recommander des améliorations aux processus d’offre d’emploi, aux processus d’accueil et d’intégration

Job Description
Work at Home Bilingual Oromo-English Phone Interpreter
Job Title: Oromo Interpreter
Location: Work at Home position in United States
Position: Phone Interpreter
Status: Independent Contractor
Pay: $0.70 - $0.85 per minute
We Offer:

• Employee Referral Program.

• Advancement opportunities within the organization.

• Interpreter support.

• An inclusive and diverse work environment.

• **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:
The Oromo Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Oromo and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.
The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.
This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.
**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**
Essential Job Functions

• Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

• Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.

• Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.

• Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.

• Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.

• Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.

• Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.

• Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.

• Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.

• **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standard

More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.

- Hunt and prospect into enterprise accounts and generate meetings with stakeholders across all levels, from C-suite executives to data engineers.

title: Jr Account Executive - Helsinki
description:
ABOUT US

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

- Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

- Create engaging ways to show our product

- Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

- Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

- Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

- Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

- Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

- Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

- Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

- Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

- Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

- A minimum of 1 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

- You are comfortable working in both English and Finnish

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Flexible time off

- Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Product Support Engineer - NAMER
description:
HELLO!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in AMER.

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a growing AMER Support Engineering team of four and contribute to how we support customers across the region. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

NOT SURE WHICH SUPPORT ROLE IS RIGHT FOR YOU?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles.

- Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling - audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing - to help customers reach successful outcomes.

- Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows-using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As a Support Engineer in AMER, you’ll work alongside four Support Engineers in the region, help shape the operating practices and handoff norms the team is continuing to develop, and bring AMER customer patterns to a global team.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN:

- Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation-investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

- Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

- Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

- Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

- Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

- Contribute to AMER coverage, handoff, and operating practices alongside the regional Support Engineering team while bringing customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

- Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF:

- You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.
